items.title: Is One Score Enough? Rethinking the Evaluation of Sequentially Evolving LLM Memory
items.title_zh: 一个分数就够了吗？重新思考顺序演化 LLM 记忆的评测
items.summary: SeqMem-Eval is a diagnostic framework for sequentially evolving LLM memory that measures online utility, hold-out generalization, backward transfer and forgetting rather than only final or cumulative accuracy. Experiments show that higher final accuracy does not necessarily imply better memory quality, with many methods suffering substantial forgetting or negative transfer.

items.title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 检索很便宜，给我看代码：面向 RAG 的可执行多跳推理
items.summary: UIUC's PyRAG reformulates multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation as synthesizing and executing Python programs over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states and enabling compiler-grounded self-repair without extra training. It outperforms strong baselines on five QA benchmarks.

items.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
items.title_zh: 内在检索：注意力模型的固有属性
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers propose INTRA, which lets decoder attention score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then reused as context, unifying retrieval and generation. It reports gains over strong engineered RAG pipelines on evidence recall and answer quality.

items.title: Many-Shot CoT-ICL: Making In-Context Learning Truly Learn
items.title_zh: 多样例 CoT-ICL：让上下文学习真正发生学习
items.summary: A study of many-shot chain-of-thought in-context learning finds that scaling, retrieval and ordering rules from non-reasoning tasks do not transfer to reasoning tasks. It proposes Curvilinear Demonstration Selection, which yields up to 5.42 points gain on geometry.

items.title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
items.title_zh: 信念引擎：多智能体 LLM 审议中可配置、可检查的立场动态
items.summary: The Belief Engine is an auditable belief-update layer that represents belief as an evidential state over a proposition and exposes it as a scalar stance, extracting arguments into structured memory and updating stance with a log-odds rule. Parameter sweeps across base LLMs show evidence uptake and prior anchoring reliably shape stance dynamics while preserving an update trail.

items.title: A Knowledge-Injection Framework for Zero-Shot Adaptation of LLMs to Delirium Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 零样本谵妄预测的知识注入框架
items.summary: The authors augment a deterministic natural-language summary of structured EHR data with an external clinical knowledge report at inference time, without fine-tuning or retrieval, and evaluate LLaMA 3.1 8B and 3.3 70B on 3,160 ICU admissions. Adding the report improved AUROC by 8.57 points for the 8B model and 1.99 points for the 70B model, while random control reports did not help.

items.title: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery
items.title_zh: 从反馈循环到策略更新：面向 LLM Alpha 因子发现的强化微调
items.summary: QuantEvolver replaces prompt-level generation-evaluation-feedback loops with reinforcement fine-tuning, converting executable quantitative evaluation into policy updates so a Miner LLM internalizes historical optimization experience. It accumulates high-quality factors in a mined factor database and improves the primary metric over LLM-based alpha-factor baselines on three market benchmarks.

items.title: Jobs' AI Exposure Should Be Measured from Evidence, Not Model Priors
items.title_zh: AI 对职业的暴露度应基于证据而非模型先验来衡量
items.summary: This position paper argues that AI job-exposure labels should be grounded in evidence rather than zero-shot LLM priors, and proposes a retrieval-augmented framework that assigns labels to all 18,796 occupation-task pairs in O*NET 30.2 using retrieved news and paper abstracts. The grounded condition was preferred in over 72% of disagreement cases under automatic and human evaluation.

items.title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
items.title_zh: MulTaBench：以文本与图像评测多模态表格学习
items.summary: MulTaBench is a 40-dataset benchmark split evenly between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks, introduced by Technion researchers. It shows that tuning embeddings to the target task beats frozen pretrained embeddings.

items.title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding
items.title_zh: Minerva-Ego：第一人称视频理解的时空提示
items.summary: Minerva-Ego is a benchmark for complex egocentric visual reasoning that pairs multi-step multimodal questions with spatiotemporally dense human-annotated reasoning traces. Benchmarking shows a large gap to human performance, and prompting frontier models with hints about where and when to look yields substantial improvements.

items.title: Sea's View on the Future of Agentic Software Development with Codex
items.title_zh: Sea 对基于 Codex 的智能体软件开发未来的看法
items.summary: Sea Limited's CPO explains why the company is deploying Codex across engineering teams to accelerate AI-native software development in Asia.
